applicability: Supplied sampled SPL under declared free-field far-field, linear small-signal same-configuration no-limiter assumptions

equations.interval: 20 log10(distance * target_voltage / target_distance / voltage), monotonic interval extrema

assumptions: level bound excludes separately declared distance and voltage bounds
Cycles threshold is a stated heuristic, not universal accuracy
Model declarations are not measured linearity or calibration
excluded: Physical source attribution or Human approval
